description: This file defines API endpoints related to user authentication and profile management using FastAPI. It includes login, get current user, update user profile, and token refresh functionalities, utilizing dependencies like database sessions and user repositories.

methods.name: login_user
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, and returns a token.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently trusted user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile
methods.description: Updates the profile of the currently trusted user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token
methods.description: Refreshes the user's access token (mock implementation).
